newsitem.title: GERMANY: German stats office-Q4 yr/yr GDP growth below Q3.
newsitem.headline: German stats office-Q4 yr/yr GDP growth below Q3.

text.p: The German statistics office said that year-on-year growth in the final quarter of 1996 was slower than year-on-year growth in the third quarter.

Statistics office official Wolfgang Strohm told reporters after a news conference that "year-on-year growth in the fourth quarter will be smaller than it was in the third quarter. In the third quarter, we had 2.4 percent growth. We won't have that in the fourth quarter."
Strohm also told reporters there had been no growth in the fourth quarter from the third. "From the third to the fourth quarter, we had about zero growth."
